name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo
note: [Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo) is an accelerated version of Qwen Image 2.1 for text-to-image generation and reference-image editing in 8 sampling steps, with native transparency support. Provide reference images through the canvas and moodboard, or omit images for text-to-image. For transparent output, explicitly request an RGBA image with an alpha channel and a transparent background. Start with 8 DDIM Trailing steps, Text Guidance 1, and Shift 6.5 with resolution-dependent shift disabled.
